1	# Flash Events Page — Deep Audit Implementation
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	InkOS Flash Events page (`/flash-events`) is currently v0.6 pre-QA with audit blockers documented in `InkOS_Flash_Events_Page_Audit.pdf`. Five P0 ship blockers, redundant tabs/filters, missing day-of-operations features (walk-in, no-show, public URL/QR, revenue close-out). Mission: take the page from "demos as broken" to **"Saturday-morning mission control"** — publish a sheet on Wednesday, fill it by Friday, run the day on Saturday, close the books before dinner.
6	
7	The audit gives a definitive verdict per element: **5 cuts · 1 move · 5 fixes · 11 adds**. This plan ports every verdict into surgical code changes against the existing implementation, reusing existing primitives wherever possible (PageShell, PageHeader, FlashEventDetailShell, formatCurrency, qrcode pkg, Resend/Twilio queue jobs, `enqueueSendDepositLink`).
8	
9	Stack A · Next.js 16 · Supabase · feature-key `flash_events` (Studio+) · brand: Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust only.
10	
11	---
12	
13	## The Long Prompt (master spec — the single source of truth for execution)
14	
15	This is the contract. Every cut/fix/add lives here. Implementation phases below decompose it.
16	
17	### A. INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE
18	
19	**A1.** Status filter on `/flash-events` reduces from 6 → 4 chips: `Upcoming · Drafts · Completed · All`. Drop `Published`, drop `Cancelled`. Cancelled events surface inside `All` with a destructive status badge — they don't deserve top-level real estate.
20	
21	**A2.** Detail page tab strip reduces from 5 → 3: `Overview · Designs · Slots`. Drop `Bookings` (fold into Slots — a booking IS a slot with a client). Drop `Settings` (the Edit button at the top opens the same editor — two paths to one place).
22	
23	**A3.** Detail page header actions reorder: `[Edit] [Publish if draft] [View public page] [⋯ overflow]`. The destructive `Cancel event` moves into the `⋯` overflow dropdown menu with red text + AlertDialog confirm. No destructive button at primary visual weight.
24	
25	### B. P0 SHIP BLOCKERS — must fix before anything else
26	
27	**B1. Slots tab Client column** — Demo data shows "—" for booked rows. Root cause: `flash_event_slots.booking_id` not linked to a `bookings` row in seed, so `slot.booking?.client` is null. The render code at [components/flash-events/FlashEventSlotsTab.tsx:91-100](components/flash-events/FlashEventSlotsTab.tsx#L91-L100) is correct; the data link is broken. Fix in seed module + add Realtime constraint that any slot with `status='booked'` MUST have non-null `booking_id` (CHECK constraint).
28	
29	**B2. Slots tab Deposit column** — Same root cause as B1. Once B1 fix lands, [components/flash-events/FlashEventSlotsTab.tsx:103-113](components/flash-events/FlashEventSlotsTab.tsx#L103-L113) will render `Paid · $100 / Pending` correctly.
30	
31	**B3. Edit form artist/location dropdowns** — code at [components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx:132-145](components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx#L132-L145) renders `display_name` correctly; the PDF "shows raw UUID" claim may stem from `defaultValue={event.artist_id ?? '__none__'}` showing the value when artist list hasn't loaded. Add SSR pre-loaded artist list verification + `<SelectValue placeholder>` polish + handle case where `event.artist_id` doesn't match any loaded artist (orphaned reference). Show name not UUID always.
32	
33	**B4. Cents-based pricing input** — [components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx:218-237](components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx#L218-L237) labels read "Slot Price (cents)" with raw cent values. Replace with a `<MoneyInput>` component that shows dollars (`$250.00`), accepts decimal input, and converts to cents on submit via hidden field. New form action `name="slotPriceCents"` still receives cents.
34	
35	**B5. Server-action `__none__` sentinel** — [app/(app)/flash-events/actions.ts:111-114](app/(app)/flash-events/actions.ts#L111-L114) accepts `locationId` / `artistId` strings raw. If form submits `'__none__'`, it gets passed to the schema. Sanitize: `formData.get('artistId') === '__none__' ? null : formData.get('artistId')`.
36	
37	### C. CUTS
38	
39	**C1.** Remove `Published` filter chip from [components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx:14-21](components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx#L14-L21).
40	**C2.** Remove `Cancelled` filter chip (same file).
41	**C3.** Remove `bookings` tab from `TABS` in [components/flash-events/FlashEventDetailShell.tsx:48-54](components/flash-events/FlashEventDetailShell.tsx#L48-L54).
42	**C4.** Remove `settings` tab (same file).
43	**C5.** Delete file [components/flash-events/FlashEventBookingsTab.tsx](components/flash-events/FlashEventBookingsTab.tsx) entirely (data moves into Slots).
44	**C6.** Delete `SettingsTab` component inside FlashEventDetailShell.
45	**C7.** Update `VALID_STATUS_FILTERS` in [app/(app)/flash-events/page.tsx:23](app/(app)/flash-events/page.tsx#L23) to drop `published` + `cancelled` (add fallback redirect logic so old links don't 404; default to `upcoming`).
46	
47	### D. MOVES
48	
49	**D1.** `Cancel event` button → DropdownMenu overflow. New component pattern at top of `FlashEventDetailShell.tsx`:
50	```tsx
51	<DropdownMenu>
52	  <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" size="sm" />}>
53	    <MoreHorizontal className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
54	  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
55	  <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
56	    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => setDuplicateOpen(true)}>Duplicate event</DropdownMenuItem>
57	    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => setCloseOpen(true)} disabled={status !== 'published'}>Close event</DropdownMenuItem>
58	    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
59	    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => setCancelOpen(true)} className="text-destructive">Cancel event</DropdownMenuItem>
60	  </DropdownMenuContent>
61	</DropdownMenu>
62	```
63	
64	### E. FIXES
65	
66	**E1.** Cover image upload — extend Edit form to support cover image upload to `flash-event-assets` bucket. Empty card thumbnail at [components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx:103-107](components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx#L103-L107) currently shows fallback Zap icon. After fix, fallback uses `event.artist.avatar_url` if present, else generates a deterministic editorial gradient from `event.id`.
67	
68	**E2.** Slots-tab `Action` column — replace lock-icon placeholder with explicit row-level dropdown `[⋯]` containing: `SMS reminder · Reschedule · Refund deposit · Mark walk-in · Mark no-show`. Each item disabled based on slot status (e.g., Mark walk-in only on `open`, Refund only when deposit paid).
69	
70	**E3.** Server-action sentinel sanitization — see B5.
71	
72	**E4.** Slots tab Draft state — keep current empty state copy, but add "Designs uploaded: N · Add more before publishing" hint linking to Designs tab.
73	
74	**E5.** Status pill styling — add `cancelled` to STATUS_CONFIG in [components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx:23-31](components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx#L23-L31) (already present; verify) so Cancelled events render correctly inside `All` filter view.
75	
76	### F. ADDS
77	
78	**F1. Stat strip above grid** — 4 KPI cards on `/flash-events` listing page above the filter chips:
79	- `UPCOMING` count — events with `event_date >= today AND status IN ('draft','published')`
80	- `SLOTS FILLED · 30D` — `booked_slots / total_slots` for events in the next 30 days
81	- `REVENUE LOCKED` — sum of `slot_price_cents` across all booked slots in next 30 days
82	- `DEPOSITS HELD` — sum of `deposit_cents` across booked slots where `deposit_paid = true` and `event_date >= today`
83	
84	KPI styling: Inter 800, tabular-nums, Onyx number, Stone uppercase label tracking-0.08em. Single Rust 2px left border on `REVENUE LOCKED` (the hero KPI per viewport).
85	
86	Implementation: new query `getFlashEventsKPIs(studioId)` in [lib/flash-events/queries.ts](lib/flash-events/queries.ts) returning typed `{ upcoming: number; slotsFilled: { booked: number; total: number }; revenueLockedCents: number; depositsHeldCents: number }`. Render in new `<FlashEventsStatStrip>` Server Component.
87	
88	**F2. Revenue projection on event card** — extend `FlashEventCard` at [components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx:78](components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx#L78) to show `$X / $Y` (collected/locked) under the booked count. Compute from new field `revenue_locked_cents` added to `FlashEventListItem`.
89	
90	**F3. Public URL + QR on Overview tab** — add new `<EventShareCard>` to `OverviewTab` showing:
91	- Public URL displayed as monospace text + `[Copy link]` button (copies to clipboard, toast "Link copied")
92	- Downloadable QR code (generated client-side via `qrcode` pkg already in package.json) with `[Download PNG]` button at 1024px
93	- Only visible when `status === 'published' AND public === true`
94	- Component path: `components/flash-events/EventShareCard.tsx` (new)
95	
96	**F4. Revenue panel on Overview tab** — new card below existing Event Details:
97	```
98	REVENUE
99	  Locked         $3,000   (booked × slot_price)
100	  Collected      $1,100   (booked × deposit where deposit_paid)
101	  Outstanding    $1,900   (locked − collected)
102	  Tips           $0       (post-event entry)
103	```
104	Server-side compute from slot+booking joins. Hidden until first slot booked. Pro+ gated visually but data always loaded.
105	
106	**F5. Design column on Slots tab** — extend `FlashEventSlotWithBooking` query to also select `design:flash_event_designs(title, size_description, price_cents)` via the slot's `design_id` FK. Render in Client column as second line: `▸ Design B (3in × 4in · $275)`. If client picked design via public booking, link is set there; if via walk-in entry, set on conversion.
107	
108	Schema: `flash_event_slots.design_id` already exists (nullable FK to `flash_event_designs`). Add query join. Add migration to backfill demo data.
109	
110	**F6. Walk-in conversion button** — on Open rows in Slots tab, action menu item `Mark walk-in` opens a slide-in `<WalkInForm>` Drawer with:
111	- Client first name + last name + email + phone
112	- Optional design picker (dropdown of available designs)
113	- `[Charge at desk]` toggle (default ON — skips deposit collection, marks slot as `booked` with `deposit_paid=false` + `booking.source='walk-in'`)
114	- `[Send Stripe link]` toggle (calls `enqueueSendDepositLink` to email/SMS the client a Dodo Payments checkout URL)
115	
116	New server action `markSlotWalkInAction(eventId, slotId, formData)` — uses service-role client to: upsert client → create `bookings` row → set `slot.booking_id` + `slot.status='booked'` atomically via new RPC `mark_flash_slot_walkin(p_slot_id, p_client_info, p_charge_at_desk)`.
117	
118	**F7. No-show fee + grace timer** — three pieces:
119	- New column `flash_event_slots.no_show_marked_at timestamptz` (nullable)
120	- New column `flash_event_slots.grace_expires_at timestamptz` (set to `slot_start + interval '15 minutes'` on booking confirmation; computed in `confirm_flash_slot_booking` RPC update)
121	- Background job `flash-no-show-sweep` (BullMQ, runs every 5 min): finds slots where `now() > grace_expires_at AND status='booked' AND booking.checked_in_at IS NULL`, marks `status='no_show'` (new enum value), converts `deposit_cents` to `no_show_fee_cents` line on the booking
122	- Slots tab new status pill `No-show` (Stone+strike-through styling, since `cancelled` palette is reserved for events not slots)
123	- Action menu item `Mark no-show` immediately on any booked row (manual override)
124	- Action menu item `Mark checked-in` on booked rows clears the timer
125	- Schema migration: add `no_show` to `flash_event_slots.status` CHECK constraint enum
126	
127	**F8. SMS reminders (T-24h + T-2h)** — on slot transition to `booked` (in `confirm_flash_slot_booking` RPC + walk-in RPC), enqueue two BullMQ jobs:
128	- `send-sms` at `slot_start - 24h`: "Hey {name}, your flash slot at {studio} is tomorrow at {time}. Reply CANCEL to free your slot."
129	- `send-sms` at `slot_start - 2h`: "Today's the day — see you at {time}. Studio address: {addr}. Reply 1 if running late."
130	
131	Use existing queue infrastructure in [lib/queue.ts](lib/queue.ts). Gated on `sms_reminders` feature key (Studio+). Cancel jobs on slot cancel/no-show via `removeRepeatable`.
132	
133	**F9. Duplicate event** — overflow menu item that posts to new `duplicateFlashEventAction(eventId)`. Creates a draft copy with: same designs (deep-copied), same slot_duration_min/start/end/max_slots/pricing, same artist/location, BUT `event_date = NULL` (forces user to pick), `status='draft'`, new slug (auto: `{original-slug}-copy-{n}`). Redirects to `/flash-events/{newId}/edit` with date field auto-focused.
134	
135	**F10. Close-out report** — new `Close event` overflow menu item (enabled when `status='published' AND event_date <= today`). Opens AlertDialog summary:
136	```
137	{Event title} closed.
138	- {n} bookings completed · {m} no-shows
139	- $X slot revenue · $Y deposits collected · $Z tips
140	- Top design: {design title} ({k} bookings)
141	- Artist payout: ${calculated}
142	[Email me a copy]   [Done]
143	```
144	Action: `closeFlashEventAction(eventId)` sets `status='completed'`, `completed_at=now()`, enqueues optional summary email to `auth.email`.
145	
146	**F11. SMS reminder dispatch UI** — Slots tab row action `Send link` — only visible on `reserved` rows where deposit hasn't been paid. Calls `enqueueSendDepositLink` with the client's preferred channel. Toast: "Reminder queued — sending in <60s."
147	
148	**F12. Cover image upload + QR/PDF flyer download** — extend Designs tab + Edit form upload widget to support cover image. Surface a `[Download flyer PDF]` button on Overview that generates a printable A4 PDF: cover image header + 12-slot grid showing time + design thumbnail + QR code per slot. Use existing PDF generation worker pattern (see `generate-consent-pdf` in queue).
149	
150	### G. EMPTY STATES
151	
152	**G1.** Listing zero events → `Create your first flash event` (Instrument Serif H2) + body + `[+ New event]` Onyx + `[From template]` outline. Template option seeds default 12-slot 1hr config.
153	
154	**G2.** Filter returned zero → `No events match this view` + `[Clear filters]` + `[Edit view]`.
155	
156	**G3.** Slots tab Draft → existing copy, link to Designs tab, hint "Designs uploaded: {n}".
157	
158	### H. BRAND COMPLIANCE
159	
160	- Bone `#F7F7F5` page bg always. Bookings/slots tables on Bone, hairline Stone borders (`shadow-soft` for cards).
161	- Onyx CTAs (`+ New event`, `Save`, `Publish`, `Mark walk-in`, `Send link`, `Close event`).
162	- Rust ONLY for: active filter chip · LIVE pulse on running events · 2px left border on `REVENUE LOCKED` KPI · `Cancel event` (in overflow) text. Max 1–2 Rust accents per viewport.
163	- Stone for all secondary text, labels (`UPCOMING`, `REVENUE LOCKED` uppercase tracking-0.08em).
164	- Instrument Serif: page title `Flash Events` (already in PageHeader), empty-state H2 (`Create your first flash event`), close-out summary title `{Event title} closed.`. Never on body, labels, or numbers.
165	- KPI numbers: Inter 800, tabular-nums.
166	- Tabular figures on every number.
167	- No emoji. No exclamation marks.
168	- All shadows from `shadow-soft / shadow-card / shadow-soft-md / shadow-lift` — never `shadow-md / shadow-lg`.
169	- All colors via tokens — no raw hex except in [app/globals.css](app/globals.css).
170	- `<FeatureGate feature="flash_events">` wrapper on `/flash-events` route. Server: `requireFeatureRpc(supabase, studioId, 'flash_events')` in page.tsx.

223	  jobName: T,
224	  payload: JobPayloadMap[T],
225	  opts?: { delay?: number; priority?: number },
226	): Promise<{ id: string }> {
227	  const queue = await getQueue()
228	
229	  if (!queue) {
230	    logger.warn(
231	      { jobName },
232	      'queue: REDIS_URL not set or queue unavailable — job dropped (set REDIS_URL in .env.local for full functionality)',
233	    )
234	    return { id: `noop-${Date.now()}` }
235	  }
236	
237	  try {
238	    const job = await queue.add(jobName, payload, {
239	      ...(opts?.delay !== undefined && { delay: opts.delay }),
240	      ...(opts?.priority !== undefined && { priority: opts.priority }),
241	    })
242	    logger.info({ jobName, jobId: job.id }, 'queue: job enqueued')
243	    return { id: job.id ?? `queued-${Date.now()}` }

5	 * Finds bookings where:
6	 *   - status = 'pending'
7	 *   - deposit_paid = false
8	 *   - deposit_cents > 0 (deposit was required)
9	 *   - scheduled_at > now() (appointment hasn't happened yet)
10	 *   - deadline has passed: now() > COALESCE(deposit_deadline_override, created_at + deadline_hours * '1 hour')
11	 *
12	 * For each matched booking:
13	 *   1. Sets status = 'cancelled', cancelled_at = now()
14	 *   2. Enqueues send-email job (booking_auto_cancelled template)
15	 *   3. Enqueues send-sms job if client has phone (optional — graceful skip)
16	 *   4. Logs cancellation
17	 */

20	import { logger } from '../lib/logger'
21	import { enqueueJob } from '../lib/queue'

55	export async function runAutoCancelDeposits(): Promise<void> {
56	  const runLog = logger.child({ cron: 'auto-cancel-deposits' })
57	  runLog.info('auto-cancel: checking for overdue deposits')
58	
59	  try {
60	    // ── 1. Find overdue bookings ─────────────────────────────────────────────
61	    // Use RPC to leverage the deposit_deadline_hours studio setting and override column.
62	    // The query uses COALESCE(deposit_deadline_override, created_at + deadline_hours * interval '1 hour')
63	    // as the effective deadline.
64	
65	    const { data: overdueBookings, error: fetchErr } = await supabase
66	      .rpc('get_overdue_deposit_bookings')
67	
68	    if (fetchErr) {

70	      return
71	    }
72	
73	    const bookings = (overdueBookings ?? []) as CancelledBookingRow[]
74	
75	    if (bookings.length === 0) {
76	      runLog.info('auto-cancel: no overdue bookings found')
77	      return
78	    }
79	
80	    runLog.info({ count: bookings.length }, 'auto-cancel: found overdue bookings')
81	
82	    // ── 2. Process each booking ──────────────────────────────────────────────
83	    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
84	      bookings.map((booking) => cancelBooking(booking, runLog)),
85	    )
86	
87	    const succeeded = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled').length
88	    const failed = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'rejected').length
89	
90	    results.forEach((result, idx) => {
91	      if (result.status === 'rejected') {
92	        const booking = bookings[idx]
93	        runLog.error({ err: result.reason, bookingId: booking?.id }, 'auto-cancel: booking cancellation failed')
94	      }
95	    })
96	
97	    runLog.info({ succeeded, failed }, 'auto-cancel: run complete')
98

101	  }
102	}

104	// ─── Per-booking cancellation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
105	
106	async function cancelBooking(booking: CancelledBookingRow, parentLog: Logger): Promise<void> {
107	  const bookingLog = parentLog.child({ bookingId: booking.id, studioId: booking.studio_id })
108	
109	  // ── Cancel in DB ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
110	  const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
111	    .from('bookings')
112	    .update({

115	      cancellation_reason: 'Deposit not paid within the required window',
116	      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),

124	  }

127

130	  const clientPhone = booking.client?.phone
131	  const clientFirstName = booking.client?.first_name ?? 'there'
132	  const studioName = booking.studio?.name ?? 'the studio'

140	      const { data: commRow, error: commInsertErr } = await supabase
141	        .from('client_communications')
142	        .insert({
143	          studio_id: booking.studio_id,
144	          client_id: booking.client_id,
145	          booking_id: booking.id,
146	          channel: 'email',
147	          direction: 'outbound',
148	          template: 'booking_auto_cancelled',
149	          subject: `Your booking at ${studioName} has been cancelled`,
150	          body: `Hi ${clientFirstName}, your ${serviceName} booking at ${studioName} has been automatically cancelled because the deposit was not paid within the required window. Please contact the studio to rebook.`,
151	          status: 'queued',
152	          metadata: {},
153	        })
154	        .select('id')
155	        .single()
156	
157	      if (commInsertErr || !commRow) {
158	        bookingLog.warn({ err: commInsertErr }, 'auto-cancel: failed to insert email comm row')
159	      } else {
160	        await enqueueJob('send-email', {
161	          to: clientEmail,
162	          template: 'booking_auto_cancelled',
163	          data: {
164	            studioName,
165	            clientFirstName,
166	            serviceName,
167	            artistName,

169	          },

172	      }
